title: No server action ships without a caller (old Circle cover upload, Circle undo, old booking confirm removed)

source.ref: Feature-path wiring scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end); owner 2026-11-18: full approval to fix the unused leftovers

detail:
Three exported server actions had no caller, so each was a callable endpoint that no screen used. uploadCircleCover (the Circle settings module uses setCircleCoverUrl and removeCircleCover from the Loom picker; PAGE-FRAMEWORK and EMBEDDED-ADMIN still named it as the pattern to mirror). restoreCircleAction (the undo for a Circle redraw, but redrawCircleAction only coaches and always returns changes: [], so there was nothing to undo; its path map and write patch went with it). confirmGuestBookingAction (the website booking confirm moved to the POST button confirmGuestBookingFormAction under SCAN-858; SCAN-834's probe still passes on the form action). Left on purpose: mergeGuestCartAction (the seam for a future guest cart), getCartAction and listSpaceTasks (pinned by tests), buildDraftAction (named by a probe).

DONE 2026-11-18: the three actions are removed and the two docs point at setCircleCoverUrl.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
